name: Wooden Oni Mask

description.content: Increases the frequency of [Blood Orbs] dropped by Survivors by [14%].
Survivors drop an additional [Blood Orb] whenever they vault, throw down a Pallet, exit a Locker, crouch, or fail a Skill Check.

quote: "It is no coincidence that man is so familiar with demons." -Renjiro's Doctrine 3:8
